dos.text: Read folder in a change or input listener after a user picks, not after assigning value yourself, openFolderPicker sets the private folder before it assigns value and dispatches, whereas a programmatic value assignment resolves the folder asynchronously in willUpdate.
Set dialogTitle, it is passed straight to nsIFilePicker.init as the dialog's title and the constructor defaults it to an empty string.

donts.text: Don't set readonly to false, willUpdate forces it back to true on every change to that property, so the inner input can never be made editable.
Don't treat displayValue as the value, inputTemplate renders displayValue || value but value stays the real folder path that the folder getter and form submission use.
Don't expect input or change when the user cancels the picker or re-picks the folder already selected, openFolderPicker returns early on both.
Don't assume a non-empty value means a real directory, getFolderFromPath catches an invalid path and returns null, leaving folder null while value keeps the bad string.
